title: Green Rate by Month
summary: The share of sessions closing above their open, split by calendar month (1-12). Each row's denominator is that month's sessions pooled across every year in your data; the numerator is the green ones. Even a decade of history gives each month only a couple hundred sessions, so read the per-month N and interval before crediting a seasonal story, and group by year instead for the quickest check on whether a pattern survived time.
deltas: monthly split over your full history, with N and 95% CI per month
swap the grouping to year to see whether the pattern is stable or a two-year artifact
